B_source_verdict.boundary: UserMenu always renders Sign out and invokes existing useAuth.signOut; action label is independent of user. Therefore it cannot prove signed in. SettingsView footer uses user ? Signout : Signin and Email user?.email ?? emdash. UserProfile.email is nullable and full_name optional, so Guest/noemail alone also cannot prove user=null.
B_source_verdict.auth_semantics: useAuthStore starts user=null/statusunknown; setUser(null) settles signed-out. Canonical restore/verification failures apply user=null with error/sessionEnded as appropriate without implying credential deletion. signOut is shared across surfaces and continueAsGuest alias. Real signout clears device auth via runSignOut; never use it merely to classify existing state.
B_source_verdict.same_source: git diff frozen9ec..current for UserMenu/useAuth/authstore/authtypes/SettingsView is empty. Runtime dependencies changed, so no native latest-main transfer.

Absence of Profile is consistent with null UI user but not a substitute for required Settings criterion.
